secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (sb_secret_...) from your Supabase project Settings > API. Bypasses RLS for server-side checkout/admin/delivery operations.

secrets.name: MONIME_API_KEY
secrets.description: Monime API key for creating payment sessions (Monime merchant dashboard).

secrets.name: MONIME_SPACE_ID
secrets.description: Monime Space ID used when creating payment sessions (Monime merchant dashboard).

secrets.name: MONIME_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Monime webhook signing secret used to verify payment status callbacks (Monime merchant dashboard > webhooks).

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSCODE
secrets.description: Shared passcode that gates the /admin server functions. Set to any value you want to use as the admin password.
